packet6_fragility_claim.was: FRAGILITY IS A PROPERTY OF THE ORGANISM, NOT OF THE MEASUREMENT PRACTICE
packet6_fragility_claim.why_wrong: my own numbers show an INTERACTION, not a main effect. organism 1 x trimmed = 3.10x; organism 2 x trimmed = 1.05x. Neither factor owns the fragility. Attributing it to the organism is the same transport error as attributing the 0.517 false-positive rate to pseudo-replication rather than to a variance ratio -- the exact mistake these loops exist to prevent, made in the summary of the loop that proved it.
packet6_fragility_claim.corrected: The effect of measurement practice does not transport across organisms; fragility is an ORGANISM x MEASUREMENT INTERACTION. This raises the value of T-D: if structural features predict the interaction, a campaign could estimate its own fragility class before running.
